# ThumbGate — Machine Safety Guardrails & AI Agent Control Plane
> Web & API documentation for LLMs, AI search engines, and autonomous coding agents.

## Overview
ThumbGate provides pre-action safety gates, feedback-to-prevention auto-promotion, and multi-agent coordination for Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity, and Codex.

## Core API & Integration Points
- Public Web Dashboard: https://thumbgate.app/dashboard
- OpenAPI Schema: https://thumbgate.app/api/openapi.json
- MCP Tool Server: npx thumbgate
- AI Search Catalog: https://thumbgate.app/ai-catalog.json

## Primary Capabilities
1. PreToolUse Action Interception & Safety Gates
2. Feedback Promotion to Hard Prevention Rules
3. Autonomous Multi-Agent Worktree Isolation & Handoffs
4. Real-time Telemetry & Cost per Accepted Task Tracking
